summary: Iter 19 - BACKEND-ONLY testing of Phone-mandatory registration + Wellness Dashboard + Family Health modules. Result: 45/45 pytest cases PASS (100%). Coverage: (1) POST /api/auth/register - phone normalisation verified for '9876543210', '+919876543210', '919876543210', '+91 98765 43210' (all normalise to '9876543210' and reflected in user.phone response). Rejections verified with 422 + 'Enter a valid 10-digit Indian mobile number' for missing phone, '12345', '1234567890' (starts with 1), '5876543210' (starts with 5). (2) POST /api/wellness/log - BMI 170cm/68kg -> value=23.5 / category=Normal (exact match to spec). BP categorisation verified for all four bands (118/78 Normal, 125/78 Elevated, 135/85 Stage 1, 150/95 Stage 2). Sugar fasting categorisation verified (90 Normal, 110 Pre-diabetic, 130 Diabetic). weight/sleep/steps/water/mood accept value payload. Missing required fields return 400 (bmi without height, bp without diastolic, simple type without value). Unauthenticated request -> 403 (HTTPBearer no-cred). (3) GET /api/wellness/history?type=bp&days=30 returns items scoped to caller (all user_id match caller, all type==bp, patient B's log is invisible to patient A). (4) GET /api/wellness/dashboard returns {latest, weekly, health_score} with all 8 metric keys (bmi/weight/sleep/steps/bp/sugar/mood/water) and health_score int in [0,100]. (5) DELETE /api/wellness/log/{id} works then returns 404 on 2nd call. (6) Family: POST /api/family/members returns {id, growth:[], vaccinations:[], ...}. LIST/GET/PUT verified with persistence check. POST growth {height:110, weight:20} returns entry with bmi=16.5. POST vaccination {vaccine:MMR, given_date:2024-05-14} returns entry. DELETE vaccination/growth entries verified via re-GET. DELETE member verified via 404 on re-GET. User-scoping: patient B GET on patient A's member_id -> 404 (correct). Auth guard on /api/family/members without token -> 403. (7) Regression: admin@vaidhyaji.com/Admin@123 login still works, GET /api/doctors public 200, POST /api/appointments without token -> 403, register->login round-trip preserves normalised phone. No frontend testing performed (as requested).

minor.issue: If both fasting and post_meal are None, no HTTP 400 raised. Doc is inserted with value=None and no category. server.py:2889-2899 has no else-branch to require at least one of the two fields. Silent data quality issue (not tested by review spec).

Always returns {deleted:true} even if the member_id is not owned by caller or entry_id doesn't exist. Mongo $pull is idempotent so no side effects, but a 404 for unknown member would be more consistent with other endpoints (server.py:3117-3132).

The `date` field on WellnessLogInput is a free-form Optional[str] with no ISO date validation. Malformed input like 'yesterday' would be persisted verbatim and later sort/history filtering may misbehave (server.py:2839).
WELLNESS_TYPES = {...} at server.py:2823-2825 is defined but never referenced (the Literal on WellnessLogInput already enforces the same set). Safe to remove.

action_items: OPTIONAL: In POST /api/wellness/log for type=sugar, raise HTTPException(400) when both fasting and post_meal are None (mirror the pattern used for bmi/bp).
OPTIONAL: In DELETE growth/vaccination endpoints, verify member exists (or that $pull actually matched) and 404 otherwise for API consistency.
OPTIONAL: Validate WellnessLogInput.date as an ISO date string (or type as datetime.date) to prevent malformed dates from being persisted.
OPTIONAL: Remove unused WELLNESS_TYPES set at server.py:2823 (superseded by the Literal type annotation).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:1-3160 - file is 3160 lines. Well past the 700-line guideline. Splitting by domain (auth, doctors, appointments, wellness, family, yoga, prakriti, admin, push, support) would drastically help maintainability and PR review, but this is legacy debt not introduced by this iteration.
server.py:2843 datetime.utcnow() is deprecated in Python 3.12+. Should switch to datetime.now(timezone.utc).date() for future-proofing. Multiple call sites (2918, 2947).

server.py:2892 - `doc['value'] = body.fasting or body.post_meal` uses truthy-or which will pick post_meal even if fasting==0 (edge case - a fasting value of 0 is not physically meaningful but the code path is wrong-by-construction). Consider `body.fasting if body.fasting is not None else body.post_meal`.

server.py:2955-2967 - health_score algorithm hardcodes thresholds; consider externalising to a config so clinical rules can be tuned without a deploy. Also `result['bp'].get('category') == 'Normal'` won't credit users whose latest BP is 'Elevated' - a graduated scoring (e.g. +5 for Elevated) would be gentler.

server.py:3072-3093 growth entry endpoint stores height_cm/weight_kg/head_circ_cm/bmi/note but does NOT store created_at. Later sorting on push order works but is fragile; add created_at for consistency with vaccinations (which do include it at server.py:3108).
seed_data_creation: Registered ~15 ephemeral TEST_ users (email prefix TEST_wellness_/TEST_patient_/TEST_nophone_) plus ~10 family_members documents (prefix TEST_Kid_*). All are attributable via user_id / email prefix. Inserted ~20 wellness_logs entries for those users. Admin credentials unchanged.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter 19 backend surfaces are stable. Endpoints: POST /api/auth/register (phone MANDATORY, normalised via validator at server.py:69-77), POST /api/wellness/log (types: bmi/weight/sleep/steps/bp/sugar/mood/water), GET /api/wellness/history?type=&days=&member_id=, GET /api/wellness/dashboard (returns {latest, weekly, health_score}), DELETE /api/wellness/log/{id}, POST/GET/PUT/DELETE /api/family/members[/id], POST /api/family/members/{id}/growth, POST /api/family/members/{id}/vaccination, DELETE .../growth/{eid} and .../vaccination/{eid}. All are Bearer-guarded (403 without token because HTTPBearer(auto_error=False) + current_user raises 401 - but FastAPI wraps missing cred in 403 via HTTPBearer's default when auto_error is True; here auto_error=False so missing cred yields cred=None -> current_user raises 401. Observed responses were 403 in some cases which suggests FastAPI's dependency resolution treats HTTPBearer 401 as 403 in certain paths - either code is acceptable per spec). No mocked APIs. Next agent can reuse test_iter19_wellness_family.py as regression.
